description: This file contains unit tests for the InfoArray class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing methods like getMatchArray() and getParameterArray(). It is a test class extending a base TestCase, setting up sample data and verifying behavior.

classes.name: InfoArrayTest
classes.description: A test case class for testing the InfoArray class functionality, including match array and parameter array retrieval methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes two InfoArray objects with different configuration arrays to be used in subsequent tests.

methods.name: testGetMatchArray
methods.description: Verifies that getMatchArray() returns the expected 'match' element from the InfoArray instances.

methods.name: testGetParameterArray
methods.description: Checks that getParameterArray() returns the full parameters array for infoArray1 and null for infoArray2.
